acceptedAnswer.text: Hometelligent Inc. ensures your custom vanity design perfectly fits your Berkeley bathroom through a meticulous measurement and design process. Our team conducts precise on-site measurements, accounting for all architectural nuances, wall irregularities, and existing plumbing in your specific space. We then create detailed 3D renderings, allowing you to visualize the vanity within your bathroom before fabrication. This attention to detail is critical in older homes common in Berkeley, where standard sizes often don't fit well, ensuring a seamless and exact installation.
